_comment: The firmware's mel front end (SharedSpectralAnalysis::computeMelBandsFrom, the NN input via getRawMelBands). The contract training must reproduce (#295, #291). 'bands' must equal MEL_BANDS[] in blinky-things/audio/SharedSpectralAnalysis.cpp; ml-training/analysis/test_mel_parity.py checks that, and checks the arithmetic against the firmware itself on golden frames.
num_bins_note: bins 0..127 of the 129-bin rFFT; the Nyquist bin is dropped
bands_note: [startBin, centerBin, endBin], integer FFT bins. Rising edge: bins start..center, weight (b-start)/(center-start), or 1 when center==start. Falling edge: bins center+1..end, weight 1-(b-center)/(end-center). Bins >= num_bins are skipped. The start and end bins carry weight 0. Bands 1 and 2 are identical ({1,2,3}); band 0 is bin 1 alone.
silence_note: band_energy < silence_threshold -> output exactly 0.0, before the log
